correctness.rationale: Every fan four-cycle is chorded by a hub spoke; independent conflict enumeration confirms the full pair classification. Fixing n distinct spoke colours gives exactly one list on each rim edge, excluding the at most four neighbouring spoke colours. Inclusion-exclusion of adjacent-rim equalities yields the displayed full chromatic polynomial. A uniform explicit n-colouring works for all \(n\ge5\) and the hub lower bound is sharp, while the \(n=2,3,4\) minima and uniqueness are handled algebraically. For \(n\ge6\) an explicit second colouring proves nonuniqueness. The extracted standalone program independently compares diamond and four-cycle conflicts and exact completion counts against two separate evaluation routes in 20 cases, plus 42 additional formula-versus-state-DP checks and checks 75 constructions; these tests are not substituted for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The complete named-palette enumeration of B/D rainbow edge colourings on the natural maximal outerplanar fan family is a motivated exact graph invariant, beyond a scalar edge-chromatic index. The polynomial has an \(O(n^2)\)-arithmetic evaluation and yields the all-order optimum census, a precise unique-to-nonunique boundary between five and six rim vertices, and test instances for stronger planar colouring estimates. This is an infinite structural enumeration, not an arbitrary finite instance or merely a rephrased chordal equivalence.
